So happy to find this cute spot with outdoor seating! The waitstaff was sweet and the food was exactly what we were looking for and quenched a hankering that I was worried could only be properly sated in my mom's hometown.  We had the Enchiladas de Tejas and a signature queso that incorporated seasoned beef, guacamole, sour cream and Pico de Gallo. They out Texased Texas with the deluxe queso and the enchiladas were perfect!  Even the frozen margarita was perfect and not too sweet. Thank you from the bottom of our hearts! We shall return!

Great dinner last night at UES location.  The fajitas with queso were terrific and our guests devoured the pork tacos.  Michael at the front desk was incredible.  Only slight negative was some hitches with service, but I think that was due to having too few people workin. Will defini return!
Very good! The queso is great. The peach habanero  margarita is also delicious. Highly recommend.
Very poor delivery.  I've now had three orders from them that were never delivered. Extremely frustrating, do not order home delivery from them if you want certainty that your food will arrive.

Came in just as the kitchen was closing and was admitted by GM. We promised we'd be quick. Was introduced to the bartender (Nick) by name. Thoroughly enjoyed the quick eats and drinks. We had chicken tacos, queso blanca, Margherita, and tequila neat. GM checked on us and made sure we were pleased. Would highly recommend based on superb service.
The queso was really salty and the food was delivered cold. They are usually pretty good when dining in. They have awesome frozen margaritas

Ordered the basic breakfast tacos with brisket for delivery and they were delicious! You get two per order. I'm not sure if dining in would have warranted something different but I like my food spicy, especially Mexican food, and a side of Salsa Verde would have made these perfect. I also ordered the Chili con Carne Enchiladas to have for dinner later and they were also very good, especially for what I would consider Tex-Mex style. Being a Mexican native Texan this hit my Tex-Mex cravings for sure! The best I've had in the city thus far. On another mobile order I tried out the chips and white queso with beef added and it was also very tasty. Chips and actual queso are a rarity in NYC so this was a nice surprise. Going to slowly work my way through the menu when I'm craving foods from "home".
Excellent drinks, happy hour n regular menu. Highly recommend!!  Good eats n drinks for all!!

I am gonna give 5 stars because I was too busy enjoying my food and drinks to remember to take pics, lol.  

I am not an authority at all as to whether the food is authentic, but I found it good.  There's the typical dishes, tacos,  enchiladas, fajitas, etc. 

The queso was really good.  I think I filled up accidentally on the chips and queso and didn't eat much of the entree when it came out - but my entree was a good late night snack when I got home. 

Drinks were good, small - but packed a punch.  

Place is somewhat small, but it was nice to sit outdoors.

First thing, the habanero salsa that is on the Shrimp tacos is EXTREMELY spicy!! Anyways -- it's been so hot in NYC and this place does not have air conditioning-- i would avoid eating in on hot days! We started with a round of margaritas and their chips and salsa. The chips and salsa were great but the margaritas lacked flavor to us. I got the jalapeño on the rocks marg and it tasted like just tequila with no real jalapeño flavor. For food my table had the veggie enchiladas, the avocado tacos, & the shrimp tacos. The veggie enchiladas were so bland, it was zucchini and squash in a flour tortilla covered in a green sauce that didn't really taste like much. Super disappointed with those. The avocado tacos were okay but also lacked flavor. As for the shrimp tacos, when you order, they ask if you want mild or habanero salsa-- be warned that the habanero salsa is VERY spicy! If you want to try but are nervous about how spicy, maybe ask for on the side.

Good enough for happy hour! Free chips and salsa to start, $8 margaritas, and $8 small plates like guacamole and queso. Everything was standard, but if you're looking for a Tex-mex place for happy hour, you'll be satisfied.

Javelina is usually my go-to delivery order when I am craving nachos (which are stellar), but last night my partner and I decided to go in person and try some of their other dishes (that maybe don't travel as well) and we were not disappointed!

We ordered the queso sampler (the Bob Armstrong with white queso was my favorite) and steak+chicken fajitas. They also give you a starter of chips and salsa - needless to say, we were stuffed by end of our meal and had lots of left overs. The portions were massive (although prices to match that). Everything was delicious, however our queso came out a little cold, which was odd, and many of the chips we were given for dipping were crumbs. 

Service was friendly and attentive too! Would def go back again - and potentially for HH, which looks like the real move here. Splitting some chips, queso, guac, and some margaritas with some mates.

Places that serve GOOD queso in NYC are hard to find, and Javelina serves fantastic queso! I do brunch here with friends every couple of months and am never disappointed. Between the queso, breakfast tacos, and margaritas I always leave extremely happy!

Being a recent transplant from Texas, we were in search of some Tex-Mex. This spot did not disappoint! I highly recommend getting the queso trio. The enchiladas were on point as were the fajitas and the nachos. We will definitely be back anytime we are in the city, and craving Tex-Mex!

I passed this place probably a million times and now I finally understand why this place is always empty. The food and service here is absolutely appalling!

We came here only because the Indian restaurant few doors down was packed and we just did not want to wait an hour.

Seeing it's a Tex Mex restaurant you can't go wrong right with tacos and enchiladas. Boy this place apparently made it so wrong! It was dry, poorly sauced, and extremely salty. 

The service also was none existent our waiter seemed like her head was in space 99% of the time and kept trying to push drinks on us even though we told her a few times no thank you.

Hard pass on this place!
When I need cheese enchiladas which chili sauce instead of red sauce (yuck), margaritas and amazing queso like they do it back in San Antonio...this is where I go.

The location is quite close/ideal if you want a quick bite in the Union Square area. The drinks look decent. They also give free chips and salsa. Unfortunately the rest of the food wasn't as good. I ordered fish tacos, but the fish was too much grease. I tried the enchiladas and it felt very bland. It ingredients didn't feel fresh/lack boldness. I think there are better restaurants out there.
Came here for drinks and snacks with my husband. Jordan and Martin were the best bar tenders. They were so attentive, even when the bar got busy. Highly recommend the mad mug queso.

Popped in on a Saturday for apps and a drinks at the bar. Martin and Jordan took care of us and were absolute gems. The food is really great and the service is even better. We had such a fun time here. Will definitely come back.
We LOVE Javelina. Only place in NYC with free chips and salsa and good queso. Paola was our server tonight and she was fantastic!!

Javelina is the best Tex-Mex available in the city. MVPs are the queso (try the Bob Armstrong) and the Mexican martini. Their staff is always friendly and accommodating. I only wish they had more square footage so it was easier to get a table!
Really good food. My dinner was delicious. The service was great! Everyone was professional and kind. I recommend the jalapeño margarita.
Good food, pleasant staff. I wish they could find something other than a chunk of landfill plastic for their takeout.

This restaurant can host larger parties which is nice if you're planning a group dinner! I got the Al pastor tacos which were yummy and juicy. When you order three tacos, it comes with rice and beans and you get to choose between Spanish rice/jalapeño rice and black beans/refried beans. I was full after the three tacos and couldn't finish the rice and beans it came with.

They have a good selection of margaritas, but I ended up choosing a cider which was good. Also loved the chips and salsa they bring out to the table!

I asked for no cilantro and was that there still would be cilantro on the guac but they can remove the cilantro garnish on top, but sadly when my tacos arrived they had cilantro on top.

Have been here numerous times, they always try to accommodate walk ins, which is nice. Haven't had a bad service, both at the bar and table. 

I loved their Javelina salad with shrimp, shrimp tacos and fish tacos, my friends had some other meat dishes and everyone liked what they ordered. It's a solid and reliable 3.5 stars.

Came here the other day for the Tippler. Unfortunately, the Tippler is only available on their UES location. Anyways, we got some food and had a decent time!

We ordered fish tacos, margaritas, and the churros. The fish tacos were pretty decent. They come in portions of 2 or 3. 2 is perfect for a light meal. However, you may want to do 3 if you're famished. Margaritas are definitely heavily poured and delicious.

The churros were a tad disappointing. They were fried, but came out pretty soggy. It comes with a side of ice cream. You get the choice of dulce de Leche or chocolate. Definitely get the dulce de Leche.

As for the service, it can be a little slow. However, I would cut the staff a lot of slack. They were clearly understaffed and extremely busy.

IG: @QueenOfAdventureNYC

Popped in for a quick dinner on a Thursday night. The place was LOUD and busy, but we got a table without a reservation. The free chips and salsa were very good and I could have quite easily eaten another portion. I got the quesadilla, which was very nice and a good portion size! Everyone seemed to be getting fajitas and queso, so I'd go back and try those things. It's a fun restaurant and I would recommend.
Great food! Definitely get the queso,. Will definitely be back when we return to NYC!

This location would not allow us to order from the happy hour menu even though there's no bar seating available. I've come to this location many times and ordered from the table. Good queso, incredibly nice waitress, ridiculous policy.

Chips and queso were great. Salsa wasn't that flavorful, and could've been spicier. Guacamole was great. The rest of the food was solid but nothing amazing, but definitely the closest Tex mex style Mexican in NYC!

I want to start off by saying that is the best Mexican restaurant I've had in NYC. It's classic Tex-Mex with great prices and huge portions. I was looking for a place to eat and walking into this place on a whim. In addition to free chips and salsa, which seems to be less and less common in the area, the white queso was out-of-this world good. My partner got the chicken fajitas and the portions were MASSIVE and the best deal we've gotten on food in the city. It's a very laidback atmosphere that's rather inviting. We're already making plans to return since the food was great, affordable and great service to boot.

Got home from a trip to Austin and was like, where do I get queso in NYC?? Javelina fit the bill. 

Easily made a reservation for a weeknight and tried:

+ Frozen Prickly pear margarita
+ Frozen mango margarita
+ Bob Armstrong queso 
+ Skirt steak fajita
+ Javelina salad

I've had better margaritas, but the food was really solid. The queso in particular was awesome! Reasonable prices/portions for the area, too.

This is a tricky one. I really like Javelina. The food is good and affordable for the neighborhood. The drinks are a little pricey, but the bartenders are great and go above and beyond to make good margaritas. The hosts are nice too.


I'm giving Javelina two stars tonight because of Valentina C. The worst service I've had in a LONG, LONG, LONG time. I ordered a cheese quesadilla that came with guac, sour cream, Pico de gallo, and jalapenos. The waitress was in the weeds from the beginning (4 to 5 table section with a runner). Valentina C. asked several times if I wanted jalapenos, to which I said "Yes, I want everything that the dish comes with", each time. When the quesadilla arrived it was not accompanied by any jalapenos. After trying to flag her down for several mins, she came by. I told her I needed the jalapenos. She went to "check with the kitchen" and came back to say that the kitchen said they put jalapenos in my quesadilla, then she asked me to pick through my food to show her there were no jalapenos. It was so rude and inappropriate. Who does that? 

I used the be a server and a bartender. The kitchen very rarely makes mistakes. I'm guessing this Valentina C. makes a lot of mistakes and the back of the house doesn't like her. 

Good restaurant. Watch out for Valentina C.'s section.

It's been such a heartbreak to watch this place deteriorate. I was so excited when it opened that I went a day too early and they weren't opening until the following day. I was there on day 1 and so many many times over the years and god it used to be SO GREAT!!! The staff used to be so friendly that you felt like that you were hanging out with friends - they always remembered you when you got there. The food has always been delicious and the drinks amazing. You used to leave stuffed and a little sideways with a big smile on your face having had the best time. 

That Javelina is gone and has been for a long time! They had a award winning marg that they never make anymore, a chicken chimichanga that was amazing that they just won't make now and they always cut their steak fajitas incorrectly so that even though the meat is delicious it's so tough and chewy and so hard to actually bite and eat....The people working there look miserable and are the furthest thing from friendly, the service is absolutely TERRIBLE, the place is dirty and the food is just ok. One time we were there with friends and we all saw rats running around in the area behind the door that is behind the bar! The ceiling above the bar is filthy and crumbling. The place is a mess and being run terribly. Such a far cry from the days when it was the place to be.

It's so sad... it was always our favorite place and for our friends as well. I miss the Javelina of its heyday. :(

We're going to make the switch and try the one uptown. Even though it won't solve the missing award winning marg or chimichanga issue we're hoping the team and service will at least be better.
A frequent diner here for over 6 years. I live to bring out of towners here, it never ever disappoints!!!

Stopped in here for the first time on a Saturday afternoon because I was really craving Mexican and I am so glad I did! I sat at the bar and the service was pretty fast and attentive. I first ordered a Prickly Pear margarita which was pretty standard. The menu has a bunch of different kinds of Queso which was a little overwhelming but I settled on the White Queso..so good! The stand out star from this visit are the chicken enchiladas...it was the best that I've had. I would definetly come here over and over again.

Javelina is a TexMex spot in New York. Giving it 3 stars since there was nothing that stood out to me and even looking at list of check ins, I forgot I had gone to Javelina. To caveat, I'm from Texas where there's a huge variety of TexMex options but still. I thought the guac was pretty good and refreshing but overall, nothing stood out to me. Price feels a bit steep for 2 tacos. Would recommend if you're craving TexMex specifically but if not just go somewhere else in NYC that's more authentic.

Had a fine dinner. Service was ok if not a bit lackluster. I had a bowl of chicken veggie soup that was ok enough. The fajitas I tried were bland. Guacamole was just ok, I've also had much much better queso. They asked for our us to leave our table right when we were finishing up. Felt lame. I would never choose Tex mex when visiting New York but friends organized this dinner. Waste of precious NYC meal. Now I'm sad.

Wow - what a disappointment. This place isn't what it used to be. First off, they told us as soon as we entered that we had exactly 90 minutes for the four of us to enjoy a birthday dinner. We're nearly 40 years old and ordered top shelf booze, so I'm sure we made their 90 minutes worth it (GROAN). Secondly, we asked a server for a cup of hot water with lemon for my friend who was suffering from a sore throat. She was told "we don't have that." HOT WATER? Nope. We asked a second server because we just couldn't believe that the answer to hot water was no. The second server told us the same thing. No can do. Sorry. Unreal. Truly put a damper on the whole experience. Then, they got one drink order wrong and one rice order wrong. Such amateur hour in terms of how they're running this place. Really regret coming here as I was embarrassed to have made the recommendation to my friends.

I am shocked this place doesn't have a strong 5 stars. We've eaten here a lot and the food is so consistently delicious. The Queso is a big crave over here, but recently I ordered the enchiladas and WOOOOOW THE AMOUNT OF YUM. We usually get the fajitas. Great quality meats. Staff is awesome. We love this place.
Foods great service is ok - good tables are not comfortable hate them but over all good vibes

- free chips and salsa
- amazing free salsa
- fajitas were filling and large protein portions were provided
- they messed up our order but didn't charge for a plate due to the delay
- excellent margarita

Overall, good service. Good food. Amazing salsa. Can't wait to return!

I order from here all the time and I always spend nearly close to 100 bucks each time because I'm not just feeding myself. I'm always feeding my family. Well the last time I ordered they forgot the tortillas that comes with the chicken fajitas. If you ever ordered something and they forgot a key ingredient or pairing, you know how extremely frustrating that can be. I called the restaurant and they said they would send someone over to drop off the tortillas, and that would've been fine except they never showed up. I will never order from them again. I can't believe this is how they treat people.
Service was wonderful!!!  Food was perfect!   Fresh and delicious!   Enjoyed the margaritas and chicken goat cheese enchiladas. Street corn was superb!

Javelina has a great happy hour offering with rotating cocktails depending on day of the week, beers, and also house margaritas from 4pm - 6pm on weekdays. I got the house margarita while my friend got a beer. Upon being seated the host did let us know that we needed to order an appetizer in order to sit at a table vs the bar, so we ordered guac which was good. Perhaps the best part about Javelina is that they bring you free chips and salsa. That alone will be bringing me back over and over. 

The indoor decor was vibrant and bring and service was good. 

There are multiple locations in the city so check them out if you need a happy hour spot.

A Tex-Mex haven in Manhattan, Javelina hit the spot for a recent Saturday afternoon happy hour. We enjoyed margaritas and real deal queso (as good as any I had back home) with a side of fresh flour tortillas, at their cozy bar. The service was a healthy dose of Texas hospitality, with our friendly bartender giving us samples of special marg creations, like strawberry and avocado-cilantro. A perfect, no-frills spot for any Texan lost in New York.

A relaxed and reasonably friendly place. 

Lots of GenZers, and they sometimes have those built-in-microphone voices (don't hate me, it's true).

Food pretty blah -- beans the texture of pureed baby food, Mexican rice tasteless, salad managed to be sweet (not in a good way). No salt or pepper or hot sauce. Drinks were ok -- different types of margaritas, not great. 

Staff friendly but overall not impressive. Probably won't return.

We came to the 18th street location. Even though we arrived before 4pm,  after leaving us sit for several minutes they refused to let my friend order brunch stating that it had just passed 4pm so brunch was not an option. We let that go and  I ordered fish tacos and a glass of white wine. The wine came in the smallest wine glass I've seen. The tacos were mostly batter, and relatively tasteless. We didn't say anything about the food but I complained to the manager that the wine glasses were very small and the wine was over priced for the size of the pour and the quality of the wine. He insisted that industry standard was 5 ounces, and that's what the wine glass was. The tiny glass might have possibly been able to hold 5oz if it was filled to the top, but it was half full and the pour was only about 2.5 ounces worth of liquid. The manager was extremely rude, spoke to us like we were idiots just bothering him and then walked away sent our check over. The staff there doesn't care anything about customer service and the food and drinks are very much over priced for the size and quality served. I will not go back and will not recommend them to anyone.

good food, excellent service BUT how can a bar not have a television that has sports.....craziest thing i have ever seen....some recored Art show being shown while the knicks are playing in the playoffs.....and no remote to change the channel....talk about tone deaf as multiple patrons ask the bartender, and several walked out...plenty of other good Mexican restaurants nearby

I wanted to life this place but outside of happy hour, food and drinks are pricey and all right. Next time I will try to come before 6 pm!

I had the Bob Armstrong with white queso as suggested by my server but it wasn't that great. I wished I went with the cheddar.  As for drink, the frozen margarita was decent.  It definitely had the right amount of the sour mix and the tequila. 

For cheese dip and the drink, the bill came out to $32 :/

I've never received worse service from a manager. I met my friends here for drinks and we asked if the 3 top next to our table was available and he said "no it's reserved in an hour," no apology or any other options for us. We then watched the manager seat three people who walked in not 10 minutes later. We asked the table if they had a reservation, which they responded no. I can't help but think it's because we were a group of POC and the people he seated were Caucasian as the manager was male and Caucasian. Really sad to see one of my favorite happy hour places ruined by a racist manager:(

Honestly it's pretty hard to find good Tex Mex options in Manhattan and this really checked the box for me. The variety and flavor of the many quesos were great, and the menu has all the Tex/mex classics you would hope for. I would call out the serving sizes are pretty large, so less is more when ordering. Pretty big inside so guessing wait times don't get too long.

I've lived in NYC for about 4 years and moved here from Texas, having eaten genuine tex Mex my whole life, Javelina was definitely up to par! I ordered some takeout: their white queso (a bit hard to find in NYC), and their steak fajitas.

The tortilla chips were great, the oil soaked the bag over time, I think that's a good sign though! It means they were freshly fried up in house. The flour tortillas were soft, pillowy thick with good chew-but not gummy- and seemed home made to me. They stuck together bit but that's probably from steaming in foil for takeout. The steak had nice thick cuts of well seasoned meat, enough fat for it to be tender, and the meat wasn't tough or dry at all. The steak tasted like it was grilled, or cooked over a smokey charcoal which nicely infused the meat. It came with PLENTY of fragrant grilled peppers and onions, sides of rice and refried beans, and a container with pico, sour cream, and *guacamole*! Most restaurants love to make guac an extra charge even as a small side, but not here! 4 tortillas and plenty of meat. All was delicious and brought back memories for me. Would love to see barbacoa on their menu one day!

I haven't been to the restaurant so I can't really speak for service or the vibe of the resteraunt, but as a Texan who's struggled to find a Mexican restaurant that has it all, decently sized guacamole, white queso, quality meat, home made tortillas, it checked all my boxes in flavor and menu items! Definitely ordering again, and might bring some friends in person one day so I can try a spicy margarita-my favorite! I've definitely ordered worse Mexican food in the city where they'll skimp out on guac giving a tiny sauce cup's worth and charge $7-$12 but not here!  Javelina's queso and steak portion definitely gave the impression that it's not the type of restaurant to overcharge and then skimp you on portions.

omg what can i say about javelina! upon walking in you get greeted by the nicest hostess as well as any other worker who you happen to make eye contact with so great t o be seen in such a fast paced environment. The food is so great the steak is delicious and the shrimp is freaking bomb so not tinyyy like other places i've gone to. lastly the manager i believe her name was teresa was really so great so nice and happy and it reflects on her workers. overall 10/10

Fun fact: I HATE it when restaurants are stingy with the AC on scorchingly humid days.

As soon as we walked into Javelina on a muggy day that would've made the Amazon jealous, I knew I was in for a nightmare of a dinner. There was no discernible air con, and all the diners looked like they had just finished a HIIT workout. Shiny and sweaty...yuck!

The food wasn't bad, but it wasn't remarkable enough to overlook the fact that I was melting. Our Habanero Queso with Chorizo was proper spicy, but that actually made the experience worse, since we were chugging (and requesting) ice cubes every 20 min. In fact, the ice cubes didn't last longer than 5 min before they were gone.

The Veggie Enchilada and Steak & Shrimp Fajitas were both fine as well, and if I hadn't been broiling, I might've been able to enjoy them. 

For what it's worth, service was pretty attentive and friendly. They seemed almost apologetic about the humidity, but not enough to either turn on the AC or explain why it wasn't on. 

In sum: hot, spicy Tex-Mex in 95-degree humidity. Not my cup of horchata, but maybe others can stand it.

Very bad service. We were never checked in on after ordering our food. I ordered a Diet Coke and never received it and we never received water refills the whole meal. The waitress never even came up to us again during our entire time there. So disappointed as we have really enjoyed their food in the past.
It's a totally fine restaurant. the service was quick, the ambiance was pleasant, and the food was good. It's nothing to write home about, but overall a pleasant experience,

I cannot speak for the downtown location but I will say the uptown location was beyond awful.  I had an incident -- so they claim -- which never, ever occurred.  I actually got a hold of the owner and he believed the lies of the manager!  Awful.  Nothing made any sense whatsoever, yet he believed their story.  The manager would not let me be served and told me I had to leave because of an "ugly" incident which I created....Either he made it up completely or it was another person.  When I went back again after being assured by the owner that I would be treated with dignity and respect, the manager looked at me and said to my face, "we are not going backwards".  I told him the owner said I could return and to let bygones be bygones owner's words), and he said to me, "that's not what he told me."  There's even another episode but I'll spare you the details only to say the owner was extremely unprofessional; he needs a course in business 101.  The manager was beyond awful -- to be kind.!  He lied and lied again, and said I would have him fired.  Those words NEVER came out of my mouth.  The waitress, too, had an attitude, but she must've been taking orders from the manager.  I will never return, nor will I recommend this awfully run place to anyone, EVER!

This is legit Tex-Mex y'all! We are in town for work, have been for quite some time. Really missing that Tex-Mex from home. This place does not disappoint!  Margaritas with good flavor and a good pour!  Crispy chips, wonderful salsa and the queso ... OH MY!  The Bob Armstrong is worth whatever you had to do to get here. Do not pass up the guacamole it is fresh, chilled and full of flavor. Moving on to the enchiladas ... we had the cheese and the chicken. Waiter was attentive and on the mark all night. It was all terrific. Literally 10 out of 10 here. A fantastic find that made us all miss home a little less.

I come here all the time, happy hour, dinner, brunch whatever. It's always a good time, I was a there yesterday and Jessica (bartender) I hope I got the name correct, she was great, super kind and just a pleasure. We moved outside because it was just so cold inside and we got dulce as our server. Not sure if she was having a bad day or just hated us but she wasn't that nice lol, I asked if she was okay and she said yes but her energy/attitude towards us said otherwise. 
Aside from that mishap with our server, food was great as usual and the drinks were perfect. Will obviously be back, javelina has theeee best queso around.

We were graciously invited back personally by the owner, Matt. All of our concerns were addressed and fixed! 

The manager on duty, Theresa, was amazing and made sure we were seated promptly. Our server, Eric, took amazing care of us the entire time! 

There is also a new White queso with brisket on the menu that we got to try. It was Excellent and might be a new favorite, besides the classic Bob Armstrong of course. Our margaritas and fajitas were a 10/10 as usual!

Thank you, Javelina for caring about your guests and being an amazing restaurant! There has been a Texas sized hole in my heart since I left the last review. I am happy to say that we will be back to eat again soon. (-:
Pretty good restaurant with great vibes indoors. Quality mexican food and great margaritas. Very nice service. Would recommend.

Tried Javelina twice this week- really good Mexican food in Manhattan! Tastes as good as the west coast street tacos! My favorite is the brisket tacos ( soft and juicy with lots of flavor). The Al pastor tacos were tasty too but I love the brisket tacos! Also enjoyed the tortilla soup, Queso was addicting too. Forgot to take pics but definitely give it a try!

white people mexican food in the best way 

everybody says they have bad service idk i doordash them

Service here was very quick! I tried the chicken taquitos appetizer, but it filled me up. I don't know exactly what was in them but the flavor was good! If you're looking for a Tex-Mex spot in the city, this is not a bad place to start!

Native Houstonian here. Javelina is the closest I've found to Tex-Mex fajitas in Manhattan. While there's no comparison to Ninfa's, Pappasitos, El Tiempo, or Chuy's, every other Tex-Mex place I've tried in NYC has been more or less inedible (Mamasitas, for instance, decided it was appropriate to forego the normal peppers/onions for broccoli in carrots, an offense that should get you carried out on a rail by any self-respecting fajita lover).

But back to Javelina: 
Pros: 
- there were free chips/salsa (I can't believe I have to say this, but I've noticed a trend in nyc to charge for chips/salsa)
- the margaritas were strong (actually too strong for me, but I know that's a plus for many)
- the white queso with chorizo was quite good (not quite a queso flameado, but good)
- the fajitas were sizzling, the meat was tender, and all the sides were good (especially the jalapeño rice)
- the decor was very Texas-themed (from the name javelina to the shiner ads along the wall)

Cons:
- the only negative note was the drinks service: our drinks didn't come until well after our food was served

Ate at the UES location. Ordered a drink and it never came. Tacos were ice cold and the side of guacamole never arrived 
Place was not busy and I sat at the bar...watched the bartender (who took my order) refill bottles, make other drinks, etc

Would never go back. Bad service and bad food

Sunday Brunch. We ordered Margaritas on the rocks...first rate. Complimentary freshly made chips & salsa. Fish tacos & Chicken Mole were delicious. Finished with Churros w/vanilla ice & chocolate sauce...Yum!

Service: 3.5/5
Food: 3/5

Nothing special. Fairly standard Tex-Mex food. I think the place is mostly for vibes + happy hour/after work drink attendees.

What I Ordered:
- Complimentary Chips + Salsa: small kick, we still ate 4 bowls
- Chicken + Shrimp Fajitas: shrimp was a little salty, chicken was tender, came with a good spread of sides, guac oxidized quickly

Amazing service, fantastic drinks, delicious food! 

Wyatt and Micah were great, were so attentive and personable!

Will definitely be back, their bottomless brunch hit the spot, and the food was perfection!

Fajitas no longer have red peppers?! Red peppers made the fajitas (getting rid of the green peppers would have been better). 
Not sure if I will order from here after this change, I've been a customer for years :(
I'd give it 6 stars if I could! The best fajitas I've ever had in NY and the spicy marg was killer.
